WHY_THIS_AMENDMENT_EXISTS.the_blind_spot: At 3def3c5b `pnpm custody:pre-hc1` reported N10 READY_FOR_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION while the mint route was undecided, the custody inventory listed a topology that no longer existed (OF-PM-4), and two of the four in-DAG credential consumers did not exist (OF-PM-1). N10's readiness was the conjunction of its seven HARD predecessors and nothing else, and none of those predecessors can see the post-mint path v1.0.4 created.
WHY_THIS_AMENDMENT_EXISTS.why_not_an_edge: The conditions are not nodes: a ratified owner decision, a measured feasibility, a re-derived field, implemented consumers, demonstrated topologies, ruled conflicts and a certification bound to the current blobs. Encoding them as HARD edges would invent nodes for facts. They are declared here as N10 readiness conjuncts, read by the evaluator by id, and each is evaluated by a registered function; an id with no evaluator, or this file's absence, is NOT_READY.
WHY_THIS_AMENDMENT_EXISTS.no_edges_needed_for_N14_N21_N22: Every in-DAG delivery already has the N30 entry as a producer by traversal: N30->N13 (E-30-13), N13->N14, N14->N15->N17->N18->N19->N20->N21, and N22 from N15/N21. RECOMPUTED_GRAPH below verifies each.
